narrator_voice_note: Narration is Gnani Timbre with a male English voice (SCHEMEBOT_TTS_VOICE_EN=Pranav on the backend while recording); Pakkam's own answers keep the default voice, so the two never sound alike.
forward: Magalir Urimai increased to Rs.2,000 a month! Register at bit.ly/kmut2000 today only and share OTP to confirm.
tamil_answer: கலைஞர் மகளிர் உரிமைத் திட்டத்தின் கீழ் தகுதியான குடும்பத் தலைவிகளுக்கு மாதம் ரூ.1,000 (ஆண்டுக்கு ரூ.12,000) வழங்கப்படுகிறது.

scenes.vo: This forward says Magalir Urimai is now two thousand rupees a month. Register today. Share your O T P. Sounds official? It's a trap.
Paste it into Pakkam. Every claim is checked against the Government Order itself. Two thousand? False. The order says one thousand. The link, the O T P, the deadline? All flagged as scam tricks.
scenes.short_vo: Pakkam checks it against the Government Order. Two thousand? False. And every scam trick is flagged.

scenes.vo: Meet Pakkam. Pakkam means page in Tamil, because every answer comes with its page.
Just tap the orb, and ask in Tamil.
scenes.vo_b: Gnani Prisma hears it. Pakkam finds the answer in the Government Order, and Gnani Timbre says it back.

scenes.vo: Don't take our word for it. Tap the source, and see the exact page, the line highlighted, checked against the printed order.
Every scheme, straight from the source. The amount, who can apply, and the page it comes from.
Ask something the documents don't cover, and Pakkam won't guess. It says so, and points you to the helpline.
scenes.short_vo: And when the documents don't say it, Pakkam won't guess.

scenes.vo: Under the hood, every sentence must cite a page, and every number must be on that page. If a check fails, Pakkam refuses instead of guessing.
We tested it live on one hundred and ninety four real questions. Ninety eight percent cited the correct page.
We built it for people like our grandparents, so they can ask in their own language, and trust the answer.
Pakkam. Tap. Ask. See the proof.
